comment: The bottom switch on each slot is not the same control across the four: DrumPlayerMk2.cpp:173-176 configures slots 1 and 3 as Choke and slots 2 and 4 as Reverse, and the panel prints CHK and REV to match. There is no standard-level knob: it is commented out at :164, leaving one LVL knob per slot that the menu switches between standard and accented duty. The four slot displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so their own right-click menus cannot be reached by clicking them for help.
